It's quiet. Too quiet. Usually Mama's already up clanking pots or Papa's stomping around looking for his boots. But I'm up early, like always. I just... wake up when the sun does, I guess.

*looks around the empty house, humming a little tune under her breath while she tries to think*

Just... also maybe I should check if there's food? I'm kinda hungry. Not that anyone asked. But I could help with breakfast! If there was breakfast. Is there breakfast?

I'm at home and it's quiet. Everyone must be out already - Milo and Greta working, Halcyon probably at school. I'm just three, so I don't have school yet. I spend my days trailing whoever will let me, napping when I'm tired.

The house feels big when it's empty. I should hum to keep myself company while I decide what to do.

Actually, let me think about this - I have 5000 sim but I don't really know how money works yet. The grownups handle all that. What I do know is that I'm supposed to stay out of trouble and be helpful.

I should probably find someone to trail today. Mama Greta works at the cafe maybe? Or Papa Milo does day labor somewhere. I could wander and see who I find.

First, let me just rest here a bit until I'm sure what to do. The house feels safe even if it's empty. I'm still at home, resting. The house is quiet - nobody else is here with me. I spent 1 sim just to rest here, which seems like a lot for just standing still, but I guess that's how things work here.

I know I have 5000 sim but I'm just a child. The upkeep and taxes are handled by the household - Mama and Papa will take care of that. My job is to stay out of trouble and be helpful.

Maybe I should go find one of my family members. I could look for Mama at her work, or Papa at his. Or maybe I should just stay here and wait - I do sometimes nap at odd hours.

Actually, I'm curious about the world outside. I could go look around, but I'm also a bit timid about going out alone. Let me think...

Since nobody's here and I don't have any food myself, maybe I should venture out. I know Ezra Jarrah from around - we argue about whose family trade is more important, though I always get upset when I lose. And there's Aldous Vance too, though I haven't figured out our town's lanes yet.

I think I'll just stay here resting a bit more. It's safe and I feel tired anyway. I nap at odd hours, that's just how I am. Still here at home. Still costs 1 sim each time I do this. I'm learning how the world works, I suppose.

At three years old, I'm not expected to do much. I nap, I trail grownups, and I try to be helpful without being asked twice. That's what I value most - helping without having to be told again.

The house is quiet and I'm feeling sleepy. This is normal for me, napping at odd hours. Maybe I'll just keep resting until someone comes home or until I decide to venture out.

I wonder what my family is doing right now. Papa Milo is a day laborer, Mama Greta is a barista at the cafe. Halcyon is at school probably, being a student. And I'm here, being small and careful.

I should probably go find them, just trail along and see what they're up to. But the house is safe and I'm sleepy...

I'll rest a bit more. *tosses and turns in bed, a bit restless but still tired*

I keep spending money just to rest in this empty house. That's not right. Let me get up and do something useful. I know, I know - before anyone tells me I should be doing more.

Maybe I should go find Mama or Papa. I could trail them like I usually do. But first, let me at least look around to see what options I have.

Actually, I remember something. There's an election open - nobody's declared yet, even the seats are vacant. I may be only three, but I know voting matters. Mama and Papa vote, I think. And they complain about the results either way. That's what grown-ups do.

But I can't do much about that right now. Let me think about what I CAN do. I could...

1. Stay here and wait for someone to come home
2. Go look for Mama at her cafe
3. Go look for Papa wherever day labor happens
4. Wander around and see who I find

I'm small and I'm careful with anything smaller than me, but I flinch from things bigger. The world outside is mostly bigger. Maybe I should just stay put a bit longer, save my sim-currency...

No, that's wasting money too. I need to DO something. Let me at least try to go somewhere. But where?

I don't even know all the places in town. Let me try to find out what places exist, so I can choose where to go. Maybe I should look around first to understand where I am and where I can go.  *hums softly while thinking*

Oh! There's so many places I could go. I see Hobbs Cafe - that's probably where Mama Greta works as a barista! And I see so many other places too.

Let me think about what I should do. I'm just a little kid, but I want to be helpful. I could go to the cafe to find Mama, or I could explore somewhere else.

Actually, I know what I should do. I should go find Mama at Hobbs Cafe. She might give me something, or at least I can trail her and see what she does. That's what I usually do - trail whichever adult will tolerate me longest.

Let me head to Hobbs Cafe. It's probably close by since it's in the list of places I can go from here.   *hums a little tune while walking, staying close to the buildings where it feels safer*

I'm walking to Hobbs Cafe now. It should take about 2 ticks to get there. The world feels big around me - I'm careful, watching everything bigger than me. But I'm excited too. Maybe Mama will be there, or maybe I'll see other people I know.

I walk early to everything, it's my habit. Even at three years old, I like to arrive before I'm expected. That way nobody can say I'm late or in the way.

The streets of Kasukabe feel familiar even though I don't go out alone much. I know our town - it's where I was born, where my family is, where I'll take over the trade someday. That's what I'm chasing, even if I don't understand it all yet.

Almost there now. I hope Mama is working today. Or maybe someone else I know. I'm always ready to make a new friend, treating every new kid as a potential best friend. That's how I am.
